description: Search live job postings by keywords, country, contract type, remote, visa sponsorship, employer and age. Returns title, company, location, salary when posted, visa reading with the quoted sentence, the employer's apply link and an OfferMagnet link that tailors a resume and applies.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country, e.g. US, FR, GB, ES, DE, CA.

posted_days.description: Only postings from the last N days (default 45).

q.description: Keywords: job title, skill or company, e.g. "machine learning engineer".

remote.description: true = remote postings only, false = on-site/hybrid only.

visa.description: yes = the posting offers visa sponsorship; no = it refuses it or requires citizenship.

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
